santanderTecnologiaArgentina_2.summary: Banking application for corporate clients focused on electronic check management, built with React and a micro-frontend architecture.
santanderTecnologiaArgentina_2.description:
ECHEQ Project.

- Implementation of a micro-frontend architecture to decouple functionalities and improve scalability and maintainability.
- Concurrent work on more than 10 projects using React and TypeScript.
- Use of Redux, Styled Components, and the bank’s internal UX libraries.
- Integration with CI/CD pipelines (Dumbo) and code quality control through SonarQube.
- Collaboration with mobile teams, applying adjustments to the Android application (Kotlin) derived from changes in the web platform.

santanderTecnologiaArgentina_1.summary: Migration and refactoring of an existing banking application, focused on operational continuity and performance improvements.
santanderTecnologiaArgentina_1.description:
CLOUDCHEQ Project.

- Performance and code quality improvements in production environments.
- Agile methodology work within multidisciplinary teams.

santanderTecnologiaArgentina.summary: Development of a corporate banking application for Banco Santander Brazil using Angular.

- Frontend implementation with Angular and NGRX.
- Unit test development using Jasmine and Karma.
- Agile methodology work ensuring code quality and interface consistency.

everisArgentina.description:

everisArgentina_1.summary: Full stack development of an electronic documentation system for a government organization.

grupoAgg.summary: Comprehensive technical support and IT infrastructure administration.
grupoAgg.description:
24/7 support for gaming venues and offices.
